tools.name: pull_stub
tools.description: Open a one-time Stubs link and write its values into the project's env file. Returns key names only. Never read or print the env file afterwards; run commands that need the values with `npx -y --loglevel=warn -- @talix/stubs@0.6.0 run -- <cmd>` (with `--env <name>` before the `--` if you pulled with `env`), which masks them in the output.

link.description: The stubs link, including everything after #.

file.description: Env file to write, relative to and inside the project. Defaults to .env.local.

env.description: Environment name: writes .env.<env>, so production writes .env.production. Used as given. Instead of file.

overwrite.description: Replace values of keys that already exist instead of skipping them.

tools.name: check_stub
tools.description: Check whether a one-time Stubs link is still sealed, without opening it.

link.description: The stubs link, including everything after #.
